name: PubPub
description_en: PubPub provides a publication website around collaboratively authored Pubs, collections, reviews and reader discussion. This profile covers the community publishing service at pubpub.org; the separately continuing PubPlatform serves custom publishing infrastructure. Current source research does not constitute an editorial or operational test.
description_zh: PubPub 围绕协同编写的 Pub、集合、审阅及读者讨论提供出版网站。本稿研究 pubpub.org 的社区出版服务；另行发展的 PubPlatform 用于定制出版基础设施。此次来源研究不代表编辑实测或运营测试。

core_features.explanation_en: Combine text and rich media in a shared publication workflow.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在共享出版流程中结合文本与富媒体。

core_features.explanation_en: Evaluate a reviewer snapshot independently of the changing draft, using the dated official version guide as a starting point.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以较旧官方版本指南为起点，分别评估审阅快照与持续修改的草稿。

core_features.explanation_en: Organize outputs and their scholarly relationships; deposit eligibility and results still require evaluation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 组织出版物及学术关系；存储资格与实际结果仍需评估。

en: Evaluate one synthetic journal article across authoring, restricted review, public release and a usable exit copy.
zh: 用一篇虚构期刊文章评估编写、限制访问的审阅、公开发布及可用退出副本。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation, not observed adoption or measured outcome.

Deployment.en: Hosted community publishing or independently operated code; current development README has external authentication and configuration prerequisites.
Deployment.zh: 托管社区出版或自行运营代码；当前开发 README 有外部认证及配置前提。

steps.en: Define publication authority, reviewer access and content rights using a synthetic article before live intake.
steps.zh: 接收真实稿件前，用虚构文章明确发布权、审阅访问及内容权利。

steps.en: Compare the intended published output and retained source, including recovery and API credentials where automation is needed.
steps.zh: 比较预期发布物与保留源稿；若需自动化，还应核对恢复及 API 凭据。

integrations.scope: Authentication options documented; no configured Crossref, institutional SSO, API client or service entitlement verified.

items.en: Indefinite keystroke history is deprecated; versions and releases are distinct from a full operation audit.
items.zh: 无限期逐键历史已弃用；版本及发布记录不同于完整操作审计。

supported_languages.scope: Content font support does not establish product interface locales.

license.scope: GPLv2 text in PubPub repository; hosted service, article licensing, dependencies and PubPlatform are separate scopes.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Homepage advertises free communities; actual signup, quotas and current paid services not tested. Historical Platform migration price is not adopted as current PubPub tariff.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 首页宣传免费社区；实际注册、配额及当前付费服务未测试。不把历史 Platform 迁移价作为当前 PubPub 价目。

sources.title: Terms of Service · PubPub
sources.research_notes_en: Read actual hosted terms: community control, CC-BY content conditions, termination and no storage warranty. Code grant checked separately; no legal/compliance opinion.

sources.title: PubPub · Community Publishing
sources.research_notes_en: Read current homepage free-community/free-version statements and publishing features. No numerical paid offer or quota verified; homepage marketing is not a tested signup or unlimited-service promise.

sources.title: A Path Forward for PubPub · Knowledge Futures
sources.research_notes_en: January 2026 explicitly cancels required migration, separates PubPub from PubPlatform and deprecates indefinite keystroke history; selected community retention may cost extra.

sources.title: Launching the Infrastructure Longevity Fund · Knowledge Futures
sources.research_notes_en: October 2026 statement supersedes earlier funding shortage for server-cost outlook, conditional on nominal 4 percent return. Not an SLA, guarantee of all future labor, or free paid services.

sources.title: PubPub's Infrastructure Transition is Complete · Knowledge Futures
sources.research_notes_en: Actual April 2026 transition complete: Docker swarm, integrated search/PDF/Impact. Performance and cost claims remain vendor statements, not measured results.

sources.title: Updates to PubPub Login · Knowledge Futures
sources.research_notes_en: Read May 2026 KF Auth redirect, GitHub/ORCID and API Bearer-token breaking change; institutional SSO foundation not interpreted as a universally configured connector.

sources.title: Privacy Policy · PubPub
sources.research_notes_en: Actual policy sections read: public profiles, embedded trackers, publisher analytics, US processing, retention/cached copies. No blanket privacy or GDPR guarantee.

sources.title: Pub Management · PubPub Help
sources.research_notes_en: Dated original 2018 reference release2 actually read: primary collections/citation, managers versus attribution, version visibility, DOI, irreversible deletion, experimental import and custom default download. Current UI and grant defaults not tested.

sources.title: Privacy, Sharing + Collaborating · PubPub Help
sources.research_notes_en: Dated 2018 official sharing release3 read: private/public view/public edit and read/edit links. Legacy description is not proof a modern sharing link is confidential or irrevocable.

sources.title: PubPub Welcome Emails · KF Notes
sources.research_notes_en: Dated 2018 KF authoring guide read: Pubs/Pages/Tags, version snapshots, community admin and discussion permissions. Concepts inform evaluation; old UI/defaults not presented as 2026-tested steps.

sources.title: PubPub Platform Update: Migration and Launch Timeline, Public, Sandbox, and Documentation · Knowledge Futures
sources.research_notes_en: Actual April 2025 plan read:3500 USD annual migration offer and unfinished archive export tooling. Historical scope only; newer 2026 independent-product statement overrides required-migration premise.

sources.title: PubPub repository LICENSE
sources.research_notes_en: Actual GPLv2 LICENSE file read; saved selected prefix includes grant and source/modification distribution obligations. Code license distinct from hosted content/service terms.

sources.title: PubPub README
sources.research_notes_en: Actual main README read, selected beginning saved: Docker/pnpm/KF Auth, SOPS+age team key prerequisite, PostgreSQL/RabbitMQ/worker; no installation or destructive troubleshooting executed.

official_check.scope: Public primary-source documentation; no account operation, purchase, benchmark, owner verification or publishing approval.

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

sections.title_en: PubPub continues; the mandatory migration plan has changed
sections.title_zh: PubPub 继续运营，强制迁移计划已变更
sections.en:
An editor choosing a home for a journal must resolve the product timeline before comparing features. The January 2026 update says existing PubPub communities can continue beyond 2026 and no longer need to migrate to PubPlatform. PubPub remains the turnkey publication builder; PubPlatform is a separate foundation for customized toolchains. A historical shutdown announcement should not be presented as the current service status.

The same update removes indefinite, keystroke-by-keystroke document history from the standard model while retaining versions, release history and collaborative editing. It offers community-specific preservation of that detailed history with associated costs. A team requiring granular audit reconstruction must establish its actual agreement rather than equating a released version with every intermediate edit.
sections.zh:
为期刊选择载体时，编辑应先厘清产品时间线。2026年1月公告称，现有 PubPub 社区可在2026年之后继续使用，无须迁移至 PubPlatform。PubPub 继续作为完整出版站点构建工具；PubPlatform 则是定制工具链的独立基础设施。不能把历史停服公告写成当前服务状态。

同一公告从标准模式中移除无限期、逐键记录的文档历史，保留版本、发布历史及协同编辑；社区如需保留详细历史，可承担对应费用。需要细粒度审计重建的团队应确认实际协议，不能把一个发布版本等同于所有中间编辑。

sections.title_en: Design the publication objects before accepting submissions
sections.title_zh: 先设计出版对象，再接收投稿
sections.en:
For a proposed methods journal, use one Pub for an article, a collection for an issue and a page to present the issue. The dated KF welcome guide explains the distinction between publishable units and page layouts, while the management reference connects the primary collection to citation and deposit behavior. This is a useful evaluation model, not a claim that the 2018 menus are unchanged.

Prepare one synthetic article with a figure, citation and supplement. Identify its authors and the person who can change publication settings separately. The management reference explicitly distinguishes attribution from document access: a byline is public credit, whereas a manager can control the Pub. Test credit, editing and publication authority as separate decisions before inviting real contributors.
sections.zh:
假设建立一份方法类期刊，可用一个 Pub 表示文章、一个集合表示期号、一个页面展示该期。较旧的 KF 入门指南区分可出版单元与页面布局，管理参考则说明主集合会影响引用及存储行为。这是评估模型，不表示2018年的菜单至今未变。

准备一篇含图、引用及补充材料的虚构文章，分别确定署名作者和有权修改出版设置的人。管理参考明确区分贡献署名与文档访问：署名用于公开记功，manager 则可控制 Pub。邀请真实投稿者前，应分别测试署名、编辑和发布权限。

sections.title_en: Check the draft, reviewer snapshot and public version separately
sections.title_zh: 分别检查草稿、审阅快照及公开版本
sections.en:
The legacy sharing guide distinguishes a private draft, a publicly readable draft and a publicly editable draft. Its read/edit links are another access route. The welcome guide describes creating a private version for a reviewer while work continues in the draft, then a public version when ready. These are dated descriptions, not a fresh permission test.

For the journal example, compare what an author, invited reviewer and signed-out reader can see at each stage. A private review discussion should not be assumed to hide the underlying article, and restricting a draft should not be assumed to retract an already public version. Use synthetic material until actual link access, publication approval and revocation are understood. Discussion moderation and editorial acceptance also need a named responsible person; neither a comment nor a saved draft proves publication approval.
sections.zh:
旧版共享指南区分私有草稿、公开可读草稿与公开可编辑草稿，读写链接又是另一条访问路径。入门指南描述在继续修改草稿时，创建私有版本供审阅，再在准备好后创建公开版本。这些是注明年代的说明，并非刚完成的权限测试。

在期刊示例中，应逐阶段比较作者、受邀审阅者和未登录读者看到的内容。不能假定私有审阅讨论会隐藏文章本体，也不能假定限制草稿会撤回已经公开的版本。在明确实际链接访问、发布批准及撤销行为前，应使用虚构材料。讨论管理与编辑采纳也应有明确负责人；评论或保存草稿都不证明已获发布批准。

sections.title_en: An article download is only part of the exit plan
sections.title_zh: 单篇下载只是退出方案的一部分
sections.en:
The site advertises imports, rich media, Crossref DOI support and exports including PDF, Word, Markdown, LaTeX and JATS XML. For the sample article, compare mathematical notation, references and embedded material in the actual output; format availability alone does not establish faithful conversion. Keep the editable source and a reader-facing copy.

The 2018 management reference calls imports experimental and distinguishes generated downloads from an uploaded default file, such as a typeset PDF. That default file may represent a different editorial artifact. The April 2025 migration announcement described a community archive/export tool still being finalized. It is evidence of a plan, not proof that a complete 2026 export and re-import works. No round trip of permissions, discussions, assets, domains or DOI references was executed.
sections.zh:
网站宣传导入、富媒体、Crossref DOI 及 PDF、Word、Markdown、LaTeX、JATS XML 等导出。对示例文章，应在实际输出中比较公式、参考文献及嵌入内容；支持格式本身不证明转换保真。应保留可编辑源稿及读者副本。

2018年管理参考称导入仍属实验功能，并区分自动生成下载与上传的默认文件，例如排版 PDF。默认文件可能代表另一份编辑产物。2025年4月迁移公告描述仍在完善的社区归档／导出工具，这证明存在计划，不证明2026年的完整导出和重新导入已可用。本研究未执行权限、讨论、素材、域名或 DOI 引用的往返恢复。

sections.title_en: Read free access and operating sustainability as different claims
sections.title_zh: 分别理解免费访问与运营资金
sections.en:
The current homepage advertises a free version and free community creation. Its public creation page asks visitors to log in; no community was created. Numeric quotas, optional services and a current paid tariff were not established. The historical3500 USD/year offer belonged to the 2025 Platform migration proposal and is not adopted as today’s PubPub price.

The October 8,2026 funding announcement says the money raised through September can cover PubPub server costs indefinitely assuming a nominal 4 percent annual return, and closes that sustainability fund. That is a stated financial model rather than a contractual uptime or support guarantee. Self-hosting still entails infrastructure, maintenance and staff costs; code availability does not make those costs zero. Price a journal’s required support, preservation and operational work separately.
sections.zh:
当前首页宣传免费版本与免费创建社区；公开创建页要求登录，本研究未创建社区。数字配额、可选服务及当前付费价目尚未确立。历史每年3500美元报价属于2025年的 Platform 迁移提案，不作为今天的 PubPub 价格。

2026年10月8日资金公告称，假设名义年收益率为4%，截至9月筹集的资金可无限期覆盖 PubPub 服务器成本，并关闭该可持续基金。这是其陈述的财务模型，不是合同式可用性或支持保证。自行托管仍有基础设施、维护与人员成本，代码可用不表示这些成本为零。期刊所需支持、保存及运营工作应分别估算。

sections.title_en: Use the current identity and API authentication model
sections.title_zh: 采用当前身份及 API 认证方式
sections.en:
The May 2026 notice directs PubPub login to auth.knowledgefutures.org and says existing credentials continue to work, with GitHub and ORCID options. Its institutional SSO language describes enabling infrastructure; it does not establish that every institution already has a configured connection. Organization accounts are introduced for grouping communities and tools.

API users face a separate migration: email/hashed-password authentication is phased out after June 30, and earlier Bearer tokens cease working because their format changed. New tokens come from account settings. If an article export job fails authentication, first inspect the deployed client’s credential method and token generation rather than trying an old password flow repeatedly. Token scopes, rate limits, retry rules and complete endpoint coverage were not verified; the public API documentation URL returned no readable body. No credential or request was created.
sections.zh:
2026年5月通知说明，PubPub 登录转向 auth.knowledgefutures.org，现有凭据继续可用，并提供 GitHub 与 ORCID 选项。其机构 SSO 文案描述基础条件，不证明每个机构都已配置连接。组织账户用于汇集社区及工具。

API 用户另有迁移：邮箱／哈希密码认证在6月30日之后停用，早期 Bearer 令牌也因格式变化而失效，需在账户设置创建新令牌。如果文章导出作业认证失败，应先检查已部署客户端的凭据方式与令牌代际，避免反复尝试旧密码流程。令牌作用域、速率限制、重试规则及完整端点范围未核实；公开 API 文档地址未返回可读正文。本研究未创建凭据或发起认证请求。

sections.title_en: Open code does not turn a development recipe into an operated service
sections.title_zh: 开源代码不等于已运营的服务
sections.en:
The PubPub repository includes a GPLv2 license permitting copying, modification and distribution under its conditions, including source and notice obligations. This code grant differs from the hosted service terms and from licenses on published articles. It should not be generalized to every dependency or to the separate PubPlatform codebase.

The April 2026 announcement reports a completed move to Docker Swarm and consolidation of search, PDF generation and community analytics. The current README’s local development procedure still assumes Docker, pnpm, KF Auth and a team-provided age key to decrypt environment configuration, alongside database, message broker and worker services. A fresh outsider should not treat that recipe as a complete credential-free production deployment. Establish configuration ownership, backup, mail, storage and upgrade procedures before choosing self-hosting. No external software was installed or run.
sections.zh:
PubPub 仓库含 GPLv2 许可，可按条件复制、修改及分发，包括源代码和声明义务。这项代码授权不同于托管服务条款，也不同于文章内容许可，不能泛化到所有依赖或独立的 PubPlatform 代码库。

2026年4月公告称已完成 Docker Swarm 迁移，整合搜索、PDF 生成及社区分析。当前 README 的本地开发流程仍假设已有 Docker、pnpm、KF Auth，以及团队提供的 age 密钥来解密环境配置，并涉及数据库、消息代理和 worker 服务。外部新用户不应把此流程当成无凭据即可完成的生产部署。选择自行托管前，应明确配置负责人、备份、邮件、存储及升级流程。本研究未安装或运行外部软件。

sections.title_en: Check content rights and preservation before putting a journal online
sections.title_zh: 期刊上线前检查内容权利及保存条件
sections.en:
The hosted terms place site content under CC-BY 4.0 unless otherwise noted and separately say submitted user-generated content is made available under CC-BY 4.0 with the necessary rights and attribution. A private draft should not be treated as permission to upload material whose rights have not been cleared. This is a description of the text read, not legal advice on a particular manuscript.

The terms disclaim responsibility for deletion or failure to store content. The privacy policy allows necessary retention and warns that cached or archived copies can remain after changes or deletion. It also distinguishes platform analytics from publisher-selected analytics and embedded third-party tracking. Decide who can publish and retain your own usable preservation copy. PubPub merits evaluation for community publishing with editorial stewardship; institutions requiring a guaranteed audit trail, recovery target or residency commitment need evidence beyond the public pages read here.
sections.zh:
托管条款规定，除另有注明外，站点内容采用 CC-BY4.0；另规定用户提交内容按 CC-BY4.0 提供，提交者需有必要权利并作署名。私有草稿不应被理解为允许上传尚未厘清权利的材料。这是对已读条文的描述，不是针对特定稿件的法律建议。

条款不承担内容删除或未能存储的责任。隐私政策允许必要保留，并提醒修改或删除后，缓存及归档副本仍可能存在；还区分平台分析、出版者自选分析及嵌入第三方跟踪。应决定谁有发布权，并自行保留可用保存副本。PubPub 适合由编辑负责的社区出版评估；要求保证审计轨迹、恢复目标或数据驻留承诺的机构，需要超出本次公开页面的证据。

seo.title_en: PubPub: Community Publishing, Review Versions and the 2026 Service Changes
seo.title_zh: PubPub：社区出版、审阅版本及2026年服务变化
seo.description_en: Evaluate PubPub after the canceled migration requirement: publication roles, reviewer snapshots, exports, authentication changes and independent hosting responsibilities.
seo.description_zh: 结合已取消的强制迁移要求，评估 PubPub 的出版角色、审阅快照、导出、认证变化及自行托管责任。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate PubPub for scholarly community publishing.
secondary_questions: Does PubPub still require migration to PubPlatform?
What does a publication version preserve?
seo.query_basis: Editorial questions; search volume, ranking and AI citation not measured.

research_gaps.en: No account, community, Pub, submission, comment, DOI deposit, token, purchase, self-host install or export/restore executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户、社区、Pub、投稿、评论、DOI 存储、令牌、购买、自行托管安装或导出恢复。

research_gaps.en: Current homepage links help to PubPlatform GitHub discussions; publicly readable legacy manuals date to 2018 and are identified accordingly. Exact current permissions, link revocation, submission routing and conversion fidelity remain untested. API docs URL returned no readable body.
research_gaps.zh: 当前首页帮助链接转向 PubPlatform GitHub 讨论；可读旧手册来自2018年，已注明年代。当前精确权限、链接撤销、投稿路由及转换保真仍未测试。API 文档地址未返回可读正文。

research_gaps.en: Actual new-community availability, quotas, paid services, DOI eligibility/fees, production self-host configuration, support SLA, backup/restore, archive completeness and contract-specific privacy/residency not established. No future solvency or delivery guarantee inferred from fund returns.
research_gaps.zh: 实际新建社区可用性、配额、付费服务、DOI 资格／费用、生产托管配置、支持 SLA、备份恢复、归档完整性及合同专属隐私／驻留未确立。不从基金收益推断未来偿付或交付保证。

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation; proposed examples were not executed.
